subject.title: feat(exec): expose knownLongFlags in safeBinProfiles config schema

question: Should custom `safeBinProfiles` let operators declare arbitrary canonical boolean long flags through `knownLongFlags`, or should recognized boolean metadata remain built-in-only?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and has real CLI/policy proof, but it changes the supported configuration and security boundary for auto-approved exec commands; tests cannot determine the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Keep metadata built-in-only
options.body: Decline the new public configuration field and retain the current model in which recognized boolean flags are curated in built-in safe-bin profiles.

options.title: Sponsor the custom-profile contract
options.body: Accept `knownLongFlags` as a supported operator setting, with the proposed denied-prefix protection and explicit documentation of its trust and approval semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep metadata built-in-only
recommendation.body: Decline the new public configuration field and retain the current model in which recognized boolean flags are curated in built-in safe-bin profiles.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline already routed the unresolved product question here, although direct ownership evidence is limited.
